headline: Shein to Pay More Than $100 Million to Settle U.S. Investigation into Deceptive Practices
summary: The US Federal Trade Commission concluded that Shein made purchase problems hard to resolve, broke shipping promises and suppressed negative reviews. It also made misleading claims about its supply chain and material origins.
why: Shein is a global online fast-fashion retailer, and regulatory settlements over consumer practices can bring fines and require changes to its business operations.
original_headline: Shein pagará más de 100 millones de dólares para cerrar investigación sobre prácticas engañosas en EU
